$comment: Theme format 1.1. The written spec, with the rules for reading and writing a file, is schemas/theme-format.md. tests/theme-format/check.js keeps this file, the designer and the Studio in step.
title: Theme Preset
description: A complete Theme Designer Pro theme with per-mode configurations (dark, light, OLED, her)

targetVersion.description: Theme Designer Pro version this was built for

repositoryUrl.description: URL to the theme's source repository, or empty for none

updateUrl.description: URL to fetch theme updates from (raw JSON), or empty for none

color.description: A CSS color, such as '#6366f1' or 'oklch(0.5 0.1 250)'

accent.description: A color as '#rrggbb', or empty for the generated one

themeMode.description: Configuration for a single theme mode. A reader fills in any field left out with its default.

c.description: OKLCH chroma in thousandths (0–150): 18 is a chroma of 0.018

l.description: OKLCH lightness percentage (0–100); 20 matches Open WebUI's own grays

paletteEnabled.description: Whether the palette from h, c and l applies. Off, the mode keeps Open WebUI's own grays.

accent.description: The mode's first accent as '#rrggbb', or empty to generate it from the palette's hue

accent2.description: The mode's second accent as '#rrggbb', or empty to generate it 40 degrees past the hue

accent3.description: The mode's third accent as '#rrggbb', or empty to generate it 40 degrees short of the hue

overrides.description: Colors set by hand for single palette steps (e.g. '--color-gray-50': '#f8f9ff')

locks.description: Palette steps locked against regeneration (true = locked)

manualOverrides.description: Palette steps set as text, one '--color-gray-N: value;' per line

manualOverridesEnabled.description: Whether manualOverrides applies. Left out while manualOverrides has text, it reads as on.

customCSS.description: Custom CSS stylesheet for this mode

autoScope.description: Whether to auto-scope custom CSS to the active theme mode

canvasEnabled.description: Whether the Canvas FX animation is active

canvasScript.description: Canvas FX animation script (Web Worker JS)

gradientEnabled.description: Whether the gradient background is active

gradientAngle.description: Angle in degrees, for linear and conic gradients

gradientStops.description: Color stops, for linear, radial and conic gradients

gradientIntensity.description: How strongly the gradient shows, in percent

gradientAnimation.description: Whether the gradient moves. Older builds wrote null, which reads as false.

gradientRadialPosX.description: Horizontal center of a radial gradient, in percent

gradientRadialPosY.description: Vertical center of a radial gradient, in percent

gradientMeshBgColor.description: Color behind a mesh gradient's points

themeShowAuth.description: Show theme colors on auth/login pages

customCssShowAuth.description: Show custom CSS on auth/login pages

canvasShowAuth.description: Show Canvas FX on auth/login pages

gradientShowAuth.description: Show the gradient on auth/login pages

themeAuthOnly.description: Show theme colors only on auth/login pages, not in the app

customCssAuthOnly.description: Show custom CSS only on auth/login pages, not in the app

canvasAuthOnly.description: Show Canvas FX only on auth/login pages, not in the app

gradientAuthOnly.description: Show the gradient only on auth/login pages, not in the app
